apps.name: Guardrail EHS
apps.description: Free, open-source environmental, health & safety and fleet safety software: incidents, actions, inspections, training, fleet, Crash Review AI and safety references, with your records kept on your own PC. Optional Guardrail Server puts a whole team on the same data.

server.name: Guardrail Server
server.description: Run your own server so your whole team shares Guardrail EHS records, with accounts, roles and a web panel. Starts as one Windows service with everything on this PC, and scales up to many servers with PostgreSQL and S3 storage (Docker and Kubernetes setups included).

apps.name: Draftly
apps.description: Modern word processor with tabs, headings, links, line numbers, pictures, tables and Light or Dark mode. Opens RTF, TXT, Markdown and Word files.

apps.name: PortHawk
apps.description: FTP, FTPS and SFTP client for moving files to and from your servers, with a dual-pane browser, transfer queue, site manager and light and dark themes. (Formerly ShoreDrop.)

apps.name: DiscHawk
apps.description: Music player for the music on your computer, inspired by Songbird: albums, artists, playlists, Up Next, ratings, lyrics, a visualizer, gapless playback and crossfade, an equalizer, radio and Last.fm scrobbling. Modern, Classic and iTunes styles in light and dark. Plays MP3, AAC, FLAC, Ogg, Opus and WAV.

apps.name: Sumthing
apps.description: Calculator with a TI-84 / TI-Nspire style graphing calculator, a scientific home screen, statistics and regressions, a paper tape, sums you type in words, a unit and currency converter and everyday tools. Light or Dark, with Modern or Classic (Windows 7) keys.

apps.name: Taskflare
apps.description: Free to-do list in the style of Microsoft To Do and Todoist: My Day, Important, Planned, lists, quick add that understands dates, reminders and Light or Dark mode. Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, Muse and Siri can add tasks for you.

apps.name: Boardwalk
apps.description: Kanban boards for your projects: as many boards as you like, statuses like New, In progress, On hold and Complete, and cards you drag between them. Quick add, undo, My week, due-date reminders, sub-tasks, blocked-by, repeating cards, screenshots, swimlanes, stats, changelogs from your cards and GitHub issue import. Light or Dark mode. Sync between devices is coming soon.

apps.name: WillowWallet
apps.description: Budgeting app: budgets, transactions with bank statement import, accounts and net worth, debt payoff plans, bills with reminders, savings goals, reports and a safe place for tax documents. Optional PIN/password encryption, and optional end-to-end encrypted sync with the Android app through your own WillowWallet Server. (Formerly CoinPilot.)

server.name: WillowWallet Server
server.description: Run your own server to sync WillowWallet between your PC and phone, with accounts for everyone in your household. Your data is encrypted on each device before it's sent, so the server can't read it. Manage it from its web panel.

apps.name: Shutterbox
apps.description: Photo and video organizer for the pictures and videos already on your PC: a timeline by day, month or year, a separate Videos section, albums, favorites, tags, search, a viewer with slideshows, import from cameras and phones, and an encrypted Locked album you open with a PIN, password or Windows Hello. Your files stay where they are. Also on Android (APK on GitHub), where it opens the same Locked album.

apps.name: Sparecopy
apps.description: Backup for your family's PCs to a NAS, server or USB drive, with one dashboard for every device at every house. Early preview: the Overview shows the planned layout and the other sections are coming soon.

apps.name: Castaway
apps.description: Media player for your own movies and shows in the style of Plex: libraries for Movies, TV Shows, Kids & Family, Documentaries, Stand-Up and Anime, in light or dark. Early preview: the Castaway server that holds and streams your media, and playback, are coming soon.

apps.name: Larksong
apps.description: Alarm clock with your own sounds and gently rising volume, wake to the radio, sleep sounds, bedtime reminders, a stopwatch and timer, world clocks and weather. Styles include Larksong, Dawn, Dusk, Retro, a clock radio with a world radio tuner, and Terminal.

apps.name: Larksong Classic
apps.description: Larksong for older PCs: one small program that runs on every version from Windows 95 to Windows 11, with alarms, a stopwatch and timer, world clocks and a bedtime reminder. Backups move your alarms between it and Larksong.

apps.name: Fleetwatch
apps.description: Look after the computers you and your family rely on — see each PC's status and updates and lend a hand remotely. Early preview.

apps.name: WriteHawk
apps.description: Full-featured word processor for documents, reports and letters, with styles, tables, comments, track changes and .docx support. Part of the Bytehawk office suite.

apps.name: GridHawk
apps.description: Spreadsheet app with formulas, charts, pivot tables and .xlsx support. Part of the Bytehawk office suite.

apps.name: SlideHawk
apps.description: Presentation app for slide decks with themes, transitions, animations and presenter view, with .pptx support. Part of the Bytehawk office suite.

apps.name: DataHawk
apps.description: Database app that does the job of Microsoft Access: tables in Datasheet and Design view with the Navigation Pane, sorting, searching and a relationships diagram. Early preview: browse four sample databases; creating databases, editing records, queries, forms and reports are coming soon.

apps.name: InboxHawk
apps.description: Email, calendar and contacts in one app. Part of the Bytehawk office suite.

apps.name: NoteHawk
apps.description: Notes app that works like Evernote and OneNote together: notebooks with section tabs and pages, a note list and a Home dashboard. Early preview: browse three sample notebooks; editing, saving, search and sync are coming soon.

apps.name: CraftHawk
apps.description: Website builder with a visual (WYSIWYG) designer and a code editor side by side, like FrontPage, Dreamweaver and VS Code together, with Bootstrap, Tailwind, Material Design and WordPress built in and publishing through PortHawk. Early preview: browse three sample sites; editing, saving and uploading are coming soon.

apps.name: PrintHawk
apps.description: Desktop publishing for flyers, newsletters, cards and brochures. Part of the Bytehawk office suite.

apps.name: PlanHawk
apps.description: Project planner that does the job of Microsoft Project: a task sheet with a Gantt chart, dependencies between tasks, the critical path and a network diagram. Early preview: browse three sample projects; adding and editing tasks, saving and opening .mpp files are coming soon.

apps.name: PixelHawk
apps.description: Photo editor with layers, masks, adjustments and retouching tools. Part of the Bytehawk creative suite.

apps.name: VectorHawk
apps.description: Vector illustration app for logos, icons and artwork. Part of the Bytehawk creative suite.

apps.name: PageHawk
apps.description: Page layout app for books, magazines and print documents. Part of the Bytehawk creative suite.

apps.name: PaperHawk
apps.description: PDF viewer and editor that does the job of Adobe Acrobat: read PDFs with page thumbnails, bookmarks, zoom, one or two pages side by side and comments. Early preview: browse six sample documents; opening your own PDFs, editing, Fill & Sign and the other tools are coming soon.

apps.name: ClipHawk
apps.description: Video editor with a multi-track timeline, titles, transitions and color tools. Part of the Bytehawk creative suite.

apps.name: FlowHawk
apps.description: Motion graphics and visual effects for video. Part of the Bytehawk creative suite.

apps.name: WaveHawk
apps.description: Audio editor for recording, cleaning up and mixing audio. Part of the Bytehawk creative suite.

apps.name: LensHawk
apps.description: Photo library and RAW photo editor for organizing and developing your pictures. Part of the Bytehawk creative suite.

apps.name: FrameHawk
apps.description: 2D animation app for animated graphics and cartoons. Part of the Bytehawk creative suite.

apps.name: RingHawk
apps.description: Video calls, voice calls and chat with your family and friends. Early preview: the Chats page shows sample conversations, and calling, chatting, contacts, meetings and voicemail are coming soon.

apps.name: AlbumGrab
apps.description: Chrome and Edge extension that saves photos and whole albums from Facebook, Instagram, Reddit and other sites, at full size, straight into a folder you choose.
